title: Vera proposes who can use an area of a Space, and the owner or an admin confirms it

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (an Admin Assistant that makes the changes the user directs, always confirming before it writes), 20:39Z (I approve everything, get this done) and 2026-11-04 06:13Z (approved to get this done); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V3 (Space Assistant: settings change, role-checked).

detail:
After LIVE-2157 Vera could propose turning an area of a Space on or off, but not who on the team can use it, which the Module Manager's lowest-role picker sets. Now, for the owner or an admin only, her Space guide carries the same role ladder the picker offers (Member, Editor, Moderator, Admin) and each switchable area's lowest role now, resolved by the turn from the Space's own feature_roles and the code defaults. She proposes a change with the set_space_role tool; the model chokepoint refuses money paths, the plan, the team list and any role off the ladder, the card says who gets in (Let moderators and up use CRM in this Space?), and a tap goes through the Module Manager's own setSpaceFeatureMinRole, which re-checks the caller and the role. An editor stays on explain only.

Shipped: veraRoleCard and the role lines in lib/ai/vera/space-guide.ts, the set_space_role tool in lib/ai/vera/tools.ts, the chokepoint branch in lib/ai/vera/model-tools.ts, the turn's minRoles in lib/ai/vera/turn.ts, the confirm in app/onboarding/vera-actions.ts, the chat button, tests and probe.
